name: Barnyard
purpose: Small-object detection inspection from near-nadir, low-altitude viewpoints.

packaged_sample.note: The configured official archive was not publicly reachable when this card was verified.

camera_policy: Near-nadir views from 18 to 45 metres altitude.
limitations: Near-duplicate frames landed in different splits; the validator penalised split leakage.
The class distribution is imbalanced enough to receive a validator penalty.
Near-nadir, low-altitude capture intentionally limits viewpoint diversity and produces small objects.
Twelve packaged frames from a three-hundred-frame source run are suitable for inspection, not benchmarking.
The configured official archive returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-15, so this card does not expose an active download link.
